cmake._comment: Plug-in set for the iOS build. If a plug-in fails to compile for iOS, remove it here: the engine still builds and the title's support level reflects the missing plug-in.

sources.comment: Self-made all-ages test game, preloaded so a fresh install has something to run.

_a11y_note: VoiceOver support is disabled on iOS: elements' accesskit host only implements the macOS adapter, and krkrz itself defaults KRKRZ_USE_A11Y to OFF for IOS. The TJS a11y APIs still exist, they just do not reach the OS.
